reflections: Ira and Eli are cooperating closely and keeping each other updated as circumstances change.
Tess is connected to a local repair effort and is actively recruiting help when there is a clear need.
Eli responds reliably to offers of coordination and is willing to step in with practical support.
Eli is consistently cooperative and willing to help with the repair effort, especially after lunch.
Tess and Dane are coordinating the work and directing volunteers to where help is needed most.
The group is sharing updates incrementally, with Vik and Ira helping spread information as details firm up.
Eli is reliable and keeps confirming plans, while also offering practical help with sorting tools and repair-drive prep.
The group is coordinating a repair-drive effort with some details still unsettled; Eli is willing to move ahead and fill gaps as needed.
Jules is cooperative and prepared, but depends on Eli for timing and confirmation before showing up.
Eli is a reliable coordinator who keeps people aligned and follows through on logistics.
Jules is cooperative and prepared, contributing tools and materials without friction.
Pia values clear timing and contingency communication so she can keep others informed.
Eli is dependable and proactive, often offering to bring materials and help coordinate tasks.
Pia and Rosa both rely on Eli for practical support and clear communication around community events.
The group appears organized and collaborative, with people sharing updates and keeping one another informed about logistics.
